name: Templater
description: Templater's templates, kept working: <% %> commands in the Templates plugin's templates (tp.date, tp.file, tp.frontmatter, prompts and suggesters in the app's own chooser, includes, rename and move, the cursor), <%* %> blocks of plain assignments, if/else and tR, whitespace control, and folder templates for new notes. Other JavaScript isn't run: it stays as written.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: To make a note from one of the user's templates (Templater's <% %> run, prompts answered): `templater_new` (`vau templater new <template> --title ... --answers '{"Question": "answer"}'`).

folderTemplates.label: Folder templates
folderTemplates.description: a template for new empty notes in a folder, folder: template ("Meetings": "Meeting"; "/" for every folder); unset, the vault's Templater settings' are used

onCreate.label: Trigger on new file creation
onCreate.description: run the <% %> commands in new notes made by the app or other plugins (not by agents); unset, as the vault's Templater settings say
